court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shishir Shirolkar S/O Kamalnayan vs State Of Maharashtra And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shishir Shirolkar, permanent resident of United States of America (USA), father
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Maharashtra And Ors, mother and others

facts_of_case: Petitioner, a US citizen, seeks return of his minor daughter 'L' born out of wedlock with respondent no.2 and transfer of her physical custody to him so she can return to USA.

legal_principles.principle: The duty of the Courts is to see that a parent who removes a child out of the country without consent does not gain an advantage by their wrong doing.
legal_principles.held: One Court should pay regard to the orders of the other foreign Court, unless it is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that to do so would inflict serious harm on the child.
cited_cases: Mrs.Elizabeth Dinshaw Vs. Arvand M. Dinshaw & Anr (supra)

legal_principles.principle: The welfare of the child is a primary and paramount consideration in all such cases.
legal_principles.held: A child is definitely not a commodity or an object, who is shared amongst the parents by dividing him/her time, life and activities as doing so beyond the permissible limits would put the child in trauma and turn his whole life far from normalcy of a childhood.
cited_cases: Mrs.Elizabeth Dinshaw Vs. Arvand M. Dinshaw & Anr (supra)

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's request for return of minor daughter and transfer of her physical custody to him is allowed.
